sourceV3.V3_AI_Evidence_Note: Retain PVS worked-example evidence assignments from rubric v2.0, including unresolved data-license/code-license distinctions. Nine contextual recordings do not establish arbitrary independent frame counts or engineering condition indices. Nine acquisition runs combine three vehicles/drivers with three scenarios, with route lengths reported. Distinguishing runs from frames supports C1/C3. Named task/context supports R1/R2. Camera 720p/30 Hz, GPS 1 Hz and inertial sensors 100 Hz, placements and processing support M1/M2/M3/M5. Roughness categories are not calibrated IRI. CC BY-NC-ND terms are stated, but compatibility with the exact intended processing/distribution remains U. Code/notebook links alone do not prove a reproducible baseline satisfying every V4 clause. Driver and vehicle factors are paired.
